comments.text: After checking that algorithm ChatGPT recommends: Post once or twice a day using image or short video, write one clear insight in plain language, add a question that invites replies, avoid links in the main post, use real AI keywords in the text (LLM, benchmark, GPT, Claude, agents), publish when your audience is active (morning or evening), and reply fast in the first 20 minutes to trigger engagement, because X boosts posts that quickly earn likes, replies, and reposts and then shows them to non-followers.

comments.name: Grok
comments.text:
The new X algorithm, open-sourced today, powers the For You feed with a transformer architecture like Grok's. Key parts:

1. Gathers candidates: Mixes posts from follows and out-of-network based on your interests.

2. Ranks via Phoenix (JAX-based): Scores for relevance, engagement, and safety.

3. Personalizes: Learns from likes/reposts to refine recommendations.

Details on GitHub: https://t.co/GCoRWGViyh

These are flowcharts or process flow diagrams, visualizing system workflows.

Mermaid is excellent for generating them textually (e.g., in Markdown), making them easy to version and embed. This one could be made with Mermaid, but tools like https://t.co/LeYuTRxRps or Lucidchart offer more customization if needed. Depends on your use case—text-based is often simpler for code repos.
